assets.name: clear-sky
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the cloudless sky layer. Image 2 is a COLOR AND REGISTRATION REFERENCE: original harbor panorama. Correct ONLY the vertical color layout of Image 1 to match the original game's sunset in Image 2. Keep output exactly 2172x724, 3:1. The previous clean sky placed its orange glow far too LOW, leaving the actual visible horizon purple. The game overlays mountain peaks at y=200 to 310 of the 724-pixel canvas, so the sky immediately above y=240 MUST be golden peach/salmon like Image 2. Deep cobalt at y=0-80; transition to dusky lavender around y=110-170; saturated warm coral peach sunset at y=180-260; strong soft golden sunrise glow centered exactly at x=554,y=298. Add the original small pale golden sun disk centered x=562,y=309, radius about 28px, partly hidden by the separate mountain layer later. Below y=340 continue the soft warm amber sky color because it will be covered. Preserve the original tiny subdued stars (do NOT increase star density) in the blue upper portion and keep the small crescent moon at x=1630,y=76. Preserve painterly brush grain, no vector or smooth plastic look. NO clouds, NO mountains, NO hills, NO trees, NO buildings, NO water, NO horizon line, NO frame or text. This remains only a continuous clean sky with stars, moon and sun, intended behind transparent clouds and mountains. Preserve original dusk lighting and palette rather than changing the time of day.
assets.initialPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one production game parallax BACKGROUND SKY ONLY from the supplied panorama (edit target). Match its beautiful hand painted storybook dusk style, brush grain and exact warm salmon / lavender / deep cobalt colors. Wide 3:1 composition, 2172x724 if possible. Reconstruct a completely CLEAR CLOUDLESS sky across the entire canvas: deep cobalt upper sky transitioning through mauve and peach to soft amber glow in the lower half. Preserve the tiny quiet stars and the small crescent moon at normalized (0.75,0.105), and the low sunset glow centered near (0.255,0.43). Remove ALL clouds, ALL mountains, hills, villages, castles, trees, shore and water, replacing them with unobstructed continuous sky. This is the lowest, static layer for a game; everything in front will come from separate transparent layers. No clouds anywhere, no silhouettes, no ground or horizon line, no frames, no text. Keep the understated painterly quality and color richness, no flat vector gradient.

assets.name: mountains
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is the supplied 2172x724 game panorama. Make a transparent PNG parallax layer containing ONLY the mountains, distant castle villages, wooded hills, shoreline and river from that panorama, at EXACTLY their original scale and placement. The peaks form the original uneven skyline around 28-44% of canvas height, the shoreline stays at 57%, water continues below. Preserve the beautiful hand painted lavender mountains, atmospheric depth, little glowing windows and river pixels. Remove the ENTIRE sky including ALL clouds, stars, moon, sun, glow and blue/orange backdrop, leaving true alpha transparency everywhere above the actual silhouette of the mountains and buildings. Trace the real irregular skyline, do not keep a rectangular sky band or a blurred blue haze rectangle above it. The mountain tops must have crisp natural soft anti-aliased alpha edges, the river below is opaque. Invariant: keep the existing panorama geometry, positions, widths and heights. Do not add new mountains or move anything. Wide 3:1 output, 2172x724. Transparent background, no checkerboard painted in, no text or frame.

assets.name: clouds
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied 2172x724 hand-painted dusk panorama. Produce the CLOUDS ONLY as a genuine transparent PNG parallax layer in the SAME original 3:1 2172x724 full canvas. Preserve the original gorgeous painterly cloud shapes and their current placement: rich deep lavender plum shadow cores with coral peach sunset rims, irregular wispy edges, large cloud banks at upper left and upper right and fine scattered small wisps between. Clouds only occupy the upper roughly 40% of the canvas as in the original. Everything outside their actual organic silhouettes must be fully transparent, including every gap between wisps. REMOVE all the blue sky, stars, moon, orange sky, sunset glow, sun, mountains, castles, hills, water, ground, without repainting these colors behind the cloud groups. No blue or orange rectangular background, no broad rectangular semiopaque fog sheet, no checkerboard drawn into the art. Keep fully opaque cores within clouds and delicate real alpha at their edges. Keep their painterly texture and detail; no rounded cartoon puffballs, no outlines, no new shapes or objects. It must be possible to place this over a contrasting colored backdrop and see that backdrop cleanly between all the clouds, down to the bottom of the image. This is an extraction of the original beautiful clouds, not a new sky scene.
